blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Online learning platforms are increasingly deploying AI assistants to provide personalized, on-demand tutoring. These can leverage infographics to communicate complex information and improve the learning experience. However, automating effective infographic generation remains a challenging task, requiring a combination of visual richness with precise typography, structured layouts, and continued editability. Existing representation methods satisfy these goals only in part: Scalable Vector Graphics (SVG) representations preserve geometry, hierarchy, and text but provide limited aesthetic flexibility, while raster diffusion models produce richer appearances by flattening content and layout into a single image. Conditioning a diffusion model on a rasterized SVG does not resolve this conflict because the raster preserves approximate placement but discards element ownership, occlusion relationships, and the structure needed to modify and recompose the result. We introduce LayerCanvas, a hybrid approach that retains SVG as the semantic, structural, and typographic program while using diffusion to aestheticize non-text content. Rather than generating one flattened raster, LayerCanvas partitions SVG elements into z-ordered sets of mutually non-overlapping elements and processes them through communicating parallel RGB generation streams. The resulting layers are independently editable and deterministically recomposed, while text is rendered from preserved vector metadata. Our approach combines rich visual synthesis with accurate typography and localized editing. LayerCanvas substantially improves text fidelity over state-of-the-art raster image generators while achieving the highest overall aesthetic quality. We further demonstrate non-destructive content editing, localization, asset reuse, and animation.
blocks.zh: 在线学习平台越来越多地部署AI助手,提供个性化,点名辅导. 这些可以利用图象传播复杂信息并改进学习经验。 然而,自动有效成像生成仍然是一个挑战性的任务,需要将视觉丰富与精确的打字,结构化布局,以及持续的可编辑性结合起来. 现有的表达方法仅能部分地满足这些目标:可缩放矢量图形(SVG)的表达方式保留了几何,分级,文字,但提供有限的审美灵活性,而光栅扩散模型则通过将内容和布局平整成一幅图像来产生更丰富的外观. 在被光栅化的SVG上设定扩散模型并不能解决这一冲突,因为光栅保持了大致的放置,但抛弃了元素所有权,隔离关系,以及修改和重新组合结果所需的结构. 我们引入了 Layer Canvas,一种混合方法,它保留了SVG作为语义,结构,和打字程序,同时利用传播来将非文本内容美化. blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: Visual explanations are a fundamental component of modern learning platforms, where instructional content is increasingly presented through a combination of text, diagrams, illustrations, and infographics. Pairing words with pictures improves comprehension and retention relative to text alone ( Mayer, 2009 ; Clark and Paivio, 1991 ) , while infographics can make dense information more accessible and memorable ( Bateman et al., 2010 ; Bhat and Alyahya, 2024 ) . As learning platforms increasingly deliver and adapt instructional materials digitally, there is a growing need to automatically generate visual explanations that are both pedagogically effective and easy to revise as content evolves. Such explanations must communicate through precise labels and clear visual hierarchy while also providing the visual richness expected from modern image generators ( Rombach et al., 2022 ; Podell et al., 2024 ; Chen et al., 2025 ) . Meeting these requirements is challenging: precision, structure, and editability are naturally supported by representations such as Scalable Vector Graphics (SVG) ( W3C SVG Working Group, 2011 ) , whereas visual richness is most readily produced by raster generative models.
blocks.zh: 视觉解释是现代学习平台的一个基本组成部分,通过文字,图表,插图,插图的组合,教学内容日益呈现. 与图片对齐的词比单文本(Mayer,2009年;Clark and Paivio,1991年)提高了理解度和保留度,而图象可以使稠密的信息更易于获取和纪念(Bateman等人,2010年;Bhat and Alyahya,2024年)。 随着学习平台越来越多地以数字方式提供和调整教学材料,越来越需要自动生成既具有教学效力又易于随着内容演变而修改的视觉解释。 这种解释必须通过精确的标签和清晰的视觉层次来沟通,同时提供从现代图像生成器中预期的视觉丰富性(Rombach等人,2022年;Podel等人,2024年;Chen等人,2025年)。 满足这些要求具有挑战性:精度,结构和可编辑性自然得到可伸缩矢量图形(SVG)等表示的支持(W3C SVG工作组,2011年),而视觉丰富性最容易由光栅基因模型产生.

blocks.en: This representational contrast has a fundamental tradeoff. Vector graphics make geometry, grouping, text, and rendering order explicit, which makes direct manipulation possible ( W3C SVG Working Group, 2011 ) , but automatically generated SVGs ( Rodriguez et al., 2025 ; Wu et al., 2023 ; Xing et al., 2024 ; Wu et al., 2024 ) often appear visually rigid, and stylizing them by hand is costly and difficult to scale. On the other hand, diffusion and flow models provide richer aesthetic priors ( Rombach et al., 2022 ; Saharia et al., 2022 ; Esser et al., 2024 ) , but synthesizing the artifact as a single raster makes exact typography and local intervention difficult; even state-of-the-art image models render dense, legible text unreliably, motivating specialized text-rendering methods ( Liu et al., 2023b ; Chen et al., 2023 ; Tuo et al., 2024 ) . These limitations are especially consequential for learning platforms, which must serve learners worldwide by localizing explanations into different languages and adapting layouts across display formats, from desktop interfaces to mobile screens. Supporting these uses requires text to remain disentangled from imagery and layout components to remain independently adjustable, properties that are lost when the infographic is flattened into a raster. A natural way then is to rasterize the SVG layout and use it as a conditioning signal for a diffusion model, letting the vector structure guide where content goes while diffusion supplies appearance.
blocks.zh: 这种代表性对比有一个根本的权衡。 矢量图形使几何,分组,文本,以及渲染顺序变得明确,这使得直接操纵成为可能(W3C SVG工作组,2011年),但自动生成SVG(Rodriguez等人,2025年;Wu等人,2023年;Xing等人,2024年;Wu等人,2024年)往往看起来很僵硬,用手来打字,成本高昂,难以衡量. 另一方面,传播和流动模型提供了更丰富的审美学前科(Rombach等人,2022年;Saharia等人,2022年;Esser等人,2024年),但将文物合成为单一的光栅使得准确的排印和局部干预变得困难;甚至最先进的图像模型也使得稠密的、可辨认的文本无法令人信服,激发了专门的文本传递方法(Liu等人,2023年b; Chen等人,2023年;Tuo等人,2024年). 这些限制对学习平台特别不利,这些平台必须服务于世界各地的学习者,将解释本地化为不同的语言,并调整各种显示格式的布局,从桌面界面到移动屏幕。 支持这些用途需要文本与图像和布局组件保持分离,以保持可独立调整,这些属性在图像平整成光栅时丢失。 自然的一种方法是将SVG布局光栅化,并将其用作扩散模型的调制信号,让矢量结构指南在传播的同时提供外观。

blocks.en: Simply rasterizing an SVG for conditioning does not resolve the mismatch: it preserves coarse spatial placement but discards element ownership, occlusion relationships, and the structure needed to recompose the graphic after an edit. This loss of structure cannot be addressed simply by strengthening raster conditioning. A system designed for editable generation should preserve these compositional units throughout synthesis instead of attempting to recover their ownership from pixels afterward.
blocks.zh: 简单地将 SVG 进行调制并不能解决不匹配的问题: 它保留粗糙的空间定位,但丢弃元素所有权, 隔离关系, 以及编辑后重构图形所需的结构 。 这种结构损失不能简单地通过加强光栅调节来解决。 为可编辑生成而设计的系统应在整个合成过程中保留这些组成单位,而不是试图从像素之后恢复其所有权。

blocks.en: Motivated by this principle, LayerCanvas combines the structure of SVGs with the visual capabilities of diffusion models. The SVG defines the semantic layout, hierarchy, paint order, and typography. Its non-text elements are partitioned into ordered, non-overlapping layers and generated through communicating parallel RGB streams, which are then alpha-composited according to the SVG z-order. Text nodes are kept outside the diffusion process entirely and rendered directly from their preserved vector metadata (Figure 1 ). Outputs remain editable, so users can replace text, move or hide groups, change the z-order, reuse illustrations, or specify animation trajectories. This makes the representation well suited to visual authoring workflows where generated content needs to remain editable and reusable, including educational content creation.
blocks.zh: 基于这一原则,Lyer Canvas将SVG的结构与扩散模型的视觉能力结合起来. SVG定义了语义布局,层次,颜料顺序,以及打字. 它的非文本元素被分割成有序的,非重叠的层,并通过通信平行的RGB流生成,然后按照SVG z-顺序进行α-复合. 文本节点完全保存在传播过程之外,直接从其保存的矢量元数据(图1)中产生。 产出仍可编辑,因此用户可以替换文本,移动或隐藏组,更改z顺序,再利用插图,或指定动画轨迹. 这使得该表述非常适合视觉作者的工作流程,其中生成的内容需要保持可编辑性和可重复使用性,包括教育内容的创建.

blocks.en: Training such a model requires examples that pair SVG with the corresponding rendered layers and final image. To create this paired supervision, we design a custom multi-agent framework, following recent work on agentic pipelines ( Jain et al., 2026 ; Huang et al., 2026 ) . The agents create concepts and SVG layouts, add illustrations, produce text-free targets and masks, and check that each example renders and reconstructs correctly.
blocks.zh: 培训这种模型需要将SVG与相应的渲染层和最终图像配对的例子。 为了建立这种对联监督,我们设计了一个定制的多代理框架,这是继最近关于代理管道的工作(Jain等人,2026年;Huang等人,2026年)。 代理创建概念和SVG布局,添加插图,制作无文字目标和口罩,并检查每个示例是否使并正确重建.

blocks.en: Our contributions are: • A hybrid formulation that separates deterministic SVG structure and typography from diffusion-based aestheticization; • A multi-agent pipeline that produces and validates paired SVGs, text-free targets, layers, masks, and provenance metadata; • A rendering-aligned layer representation that supports parallel generation, explicit occlusion modeling, and deterministic z-order composition, yielding over 25 % 25\% higher placement-exact OCR character accuracy and approximately 27 % 27\% higher aggregate aesthetic quality than the strongest raster baseline • Practical workflows for non-destructive editing, localization, asset reuse, and animated visual explanations.

blocks.en: 2 Related Work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en: Automatic graphic design combines templates, constraints, retrieval, and learned layouts; neural methods generate sets or sequences of labeled regions, including alignment and overlap structure ( Li et al., 2019 ; Gupta et al., 2021 ; Inoue et al., 2023 ) . Such representations organize posters, slides, and documents, but do not by themselves resolve illustration appearance, occlusion, or editable object ownership. Programmatic graphics preserve structure, yet hand-authored styling and rigid templates scale poorly to open-ended concepts. Image generators provide richer aesthetics, and text-aware methods introduce character encoders, rendered-glyph conditions, OCR objectives, or localized controls ( Chen et al., 2023 ; Yang et al., 2024b ; Tuo et al., 2024 ) . Instead, we retain SVG as the source of truth for geometry and typography, remove text from diffusion targets, and render editable vector text after aestheticization.
blocks.zh: 自动图形设计结合了模板,约束,检索,以及学到的布局;神经方法生成标注区域的套集或序列,包括对齐和重叠结构(Li等人,2019年;Gupta等人,2021年;Inoue等人,2023年). 这种表示方式组织海报、幻灯片和文件,但本身并不解决插图外观、封存或可编辑对象的所有权问题。 程序图形保存结构,然而手写造型和刚性模板的尺度差于开放式概念. 图像生成器提供了更丰富的美学,文本感知方法引入了字符编码器,渲染的glyph条件,OCR目标,或局部控制(Chen等人,2023年;Yang等人,2024年b;Tuo等人,2024年). 相反,我们保留SVG作为几何学和打字的真理来源,从传播目标中删除文本,并在美化后使可编辑的矢量文本.

blocks.en: ControlNet and T2I-Adapter condition pretrained diffusion models on spatial signals ( Zhang et al., 2023 ; Mou et al., 2024 ) , while grounded, reference-conditioned, and regional methods add box, entity, exemplar, or prompt-region controls ( Li et al., 2023 ; Ye et al., 2023 ; Bar-Tal et al., 2023 ) . These approaches improve spatial control but typically produce a single entangled raster or latent field, limiting direct editing after sampling. Object-centric, compositional, and layer-aware models separate entities, concepts, transparency, or foreground/background content ( Burgess et al., 2019 ; Locatello et al., 2020 ; Avrahami et al., 2023 ; Zhang and Agrawala, 2024 ) , with recent methods explicitly generating or recovering editable image layers ( Yang et al., 2024a ; Yin et al., 2025 ; Wang et al., 2026 ) . In contrast, LayerCanvas uses SVG layer identity as explicit conditioning, packing mutually non-overlapping elements into ordered RGB layer sets. This known layer structure makes output decomposition and local intervention intrinsic to the representation, rather than requiring layers to be recovered post hoc.
blocks.zh: ControlNet和T2I-Adapter条件对空间信号的传播模型进行预先训练(Zhang等人,2023年;Mou等人,2024年),虽然已经禁用,有参考条件,区域方法也增加了框,实体,实例,或快速区域控制(Li等人,2023年;Ye等人,2023年;Bar-Tal等人,2023年). 这些方法改进了空间控制,但通常产生单一的缠绕光栅或潜伏场,限制了取样后的直接编辑。 以物体为中心,组成,层意识模型分离的实体,概念,透明度,或前景/背景内容(Burgess等人,2019年;Locelleo等人,2020年;Avrahami等人,2023年;Zhang和Agrawala,2024年),最近的方法明确生成或恢复可编辑图像层(Yang等人,2024a年); Yin等人,2025;Wang等人,2026). 相比之下,LyerCanvas则使用SVG层特性作为明确的条件,将互不重叠的元素包装到订购的RGB层集中. 这种已知的层层结构使得输出分解和局部干预是代表内在的,而不是要求层层恢复后临时.

blocks.en: Foundation models have increasingly been used to generate instructions, propose examples, and curate synthetic multimodal supervision ( Wang et al., 2023 ; Liu et al., 2023a ; Gadre et al., 2023 ) . More recent agentic pipelines extend this paradigm by coordinating specialized agents for scientific tasks, including translating NeRF papers into executable code and automating the generation of editable scientific figures ( Jain et al., 2026 ; Huang et al., 2026 ) . These systems demonstrate the potential of agentic workflows for generating and iteratively refining structured scientific artifacts. Our pipeline builds on this agentic paradigm by combining specialized generative and validation agents with deterministic SVG parsing, rendering, OCR, overlap analysis, and alpha-composition checks, producing mechanically validated training records.
blocks.zh: 越来越多地使用基础模型来编制说明书、提出实例并管理合成多式联运监督(Wang等人,2023年;Liu等人,2023年a; Gadre等人,2023年). 较近期的代理管道通过协调从事科学任务的专门代理人,包括将NERF论文翻译为可执行代码,并使可编辑科学人物的产生自动化(Jain等人,2026年;Huang等人,2026年)。 这些系统显示了代理工作流程产生和迭代改进结构化科学文物的潜力。 我们的管道以这种代理模式为基础,将专门的基因鉴定剂和鉴定剂与确定性SVG解析、渲染、OCR、重叠分析和α组合检查结合起来,产生经机械验证的训练记录。

blocks.en:
LayerCanvas generates all layers together, but separate layers can easily drift
toward different colors, lighting, or object identities. Following the
continuous interpolation used in flow matching ( Lipman et al., 2023 ) ,
we give
them part of the same starting noise and use the same denoising timestep.
This encourages a common look while preserving private noise for
layer-specific detail. Shared noise cannot make one layer respond to another,
however, so the frozen image backbone needs a small trainable adapter. The
adapter follows the efficient frozen-backbone conditioning strategy of
ControlNet and T2I-Adapter ( Zhang et al., 2023 ; Mou et al., 2024 ) , but
operates across an ordered layer set so that each layer is influenced by the other. It answers three questions: which layer is being generated, which other
layers matter to it, and whether their effect should be global or limited to
a shared boundary.

We compare four methods on shared held-out layouts. The LLM-authored
SVG reference recolors and completes the structural SVG and renders it, giving
exact vector text by construction but no learned aestheticization. The two
prompt-only open-weight SOTA diffusion baselines, Qwen-Image-2512 ( Qwen Team, 2025a ) and Ideogram-4 ( Ideogram AI, 2026 ) ,
are each conditioned on the design-concept prompt derived from the input SVG layout; for Ideogram-4 this prompt is
constructed from the same SVG layout, with its structural elements serialized
into the structured prompt format the model expects. LayerCanvas is our grouped
layer-set diffusion model with deterministic exact-SVG text compositing with the MMDiT backbone as Ideogram AI (2026) .
For evaluation, all methods are placed on a 768 × 512 768{\times}512 canvas.

ground-truth-region OCR Tesseract OCR contributors (2026) at 768 × 512 768{\times}512 , and reports character accuracy and exact-match rate. Placement-agnostic fidelity runs full-image OCR at the same resolution and
measures word recall, how much of the ground-truth text appears anywhere in the
image, so a baseline that renders readable text at the wrong position still gets
credit. The two exact-text methods place

blocks.en: 5 Downstream applications

blocks.en:
Because LayerCanvas preserves SVG structure alongside independently addressable
raster layers, a generated design can be adapted without regenerating the whole
image. Vector text supports changes to wording, typography, and language, while
separate visual layers enable animation, asset reuse, and local element edits such as removing a card or swapping an
icon while preserving unaffected content.
Retained grouping and paint order further support layout retargeting, re-theming,
and SVG-level corrections while limiting changes to the intended components.
Together, these capabilities turn a generated infographic into a reusable
authoring artifact. We highlight three below; the rest are detailed in
Appendix C .

We adapt the zero-shot animation principle of

temporal operation target one named image layer while all other layers
remain fixed: every unselected image layer and the full-resolution SVG
typography are copied identically into every frame.

blocks.en: 6 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 6 结论

blocks.en: We formulate infographic generation as structured aestheticization: a deterministic SVG supplies geometry, hierarchy, typography, while parallel layer-set generation supplies visual appearance. Aligning this representation with the renderer supports many downstream applications like editing and artifact reuse. Enforcing generalization to more layouts and improving transformations under changed occlusion remain important research directions.

blocks.en:
Training LayerCanvas requires a form of supervision that, to our knowledge, no
existing corpus provides: infographics paired at the level of individual,
renderer-aligned layers. A usable training record must expose, for a single
graphic, (i) a structural program that fixes geometry, hierarchy, paint order,
and typography; (ii) an aestheticized, text-free rendering of that program; and
(iii) a decomposition of that rendering into ordered, mutually non-overlapping
RGBA layers with amodal and visible masks. Public SVG datasets supply
programs but no rich appearance, while raster infographic collections supply
appearance but discard element ownership, occlusion, and text metadata. We
therefore synthesize the corpus with a multi-agent generation pipeline
that couples a large language model, which designs and validates editable SVG
programs, with a diffusion image editor, which aestheticizes only the non-text
visual content. The pipeline is designed so that every artifact LayerCanvas
consumes at training time, namely the colorless structural input, the text-free
target, the per-layer amodal/visible assets, and the graph of overlap and
hierarchy relations, is produced deterministically from an SVG the agent has
already checked, rather than recovered from pixels after the fact.

blocks.en: A.2 Multi-agent generation pipeline

blocks.en:
The pipeline proceeds in four stages. A design stage authors a structured,
editable SVG program from a concept; an extraction stage renders the structural
input and the text-free layout and serializes structured conditioning; an
aestheticization stage restyles each editable region with a diffusion image
editor; and a composition stage mattes and reinserts the styled illustrations in
paint order. All appearance in the final target originates in the SVG program or
in the diffusion edits of its tagged regions, never in a free-form raster of the
whole scene.

blocks.en:
A design agent, built on a large language model, turns a concept into a
complete, standalone SVG on a fixed 1536 × 1024 1536\times 1024 canvas. Beyond producing an
aesthetic educational layout, the agent must mark at least one editable-visual group: a coarse vector placeholder standing in for a
tangible, photographable subject (a robot, a database cylinder, a brass scale, a
stack of coins). Each such group is emitted with a strict, machine-parseable
signature, <g id="editable-visual- k " data-role="editable-visual" data-visual-desc="…" data-edit-prompt="…">…</g> , where data-edit-prompt is the exact, self-contained instruction later
handed to the diffusion editor. To prevent the corpus from collapsing onto a
single visual template, the agent is assigned one of fourteen layout archetypes
per concept (hero-left, hub-and-spoke, comparison-split, circular-cycle,
above-below, quadrant-grid, timeline, and others), rotated deterministically
across a batch and treated as an adaptable starting structure rather than a rigid
template. The prompt enforces explicit layout discipline (shared alignment
gridlines, equal gaps for repeated elements, symmetry matched to the number of
editable visuals) and an aesthetic direction tuned for legibility (light airy
backgrounds, per-section color coding, a strong title/subtitle/takeaway
hierarchy). A guard explicitly forbids screens, dashboards, spreadsheets, and
other flat, text-bearing objects from being marked editable, because such
subjects photorealize poorly and reintroduce garbled text; those elements remain
crisp vector content. The agent operates in a render-and-inspect loop: it
rasterizes its SVG, examines the image, and performs at least one revision pass
to correct misalignment, uneven spacing, dead space, or low-contrast text before
emitting a manifest of its editable groups.

role (title/heading/label), normalized bounding box, font family, size, weight,
and fill; every illustration with its identifier, description, the data-edit-prompt , its bounding box, and its z-index; and a global style
block listing the design palette (hex swatches), font families, and mean corner
radius. This record is the interface between deterministic structure and
diffusion aestheticization used throughout the method.

blocks.en:
For every sample we additionally emit the amodal layer decomposition. Each top-level layer is rendered in isolation
to recover its amodal silhouette (its complete support as if nothing
occluded it) and its visible mask (the pixels surviving occlusion by all
higher-z layers); their difference is exactly the occluded region. Editable
layers take their amodal pixels from the matted realistic render, reconstructed
with the same parameters used in composition, so that they agree with the final
target. We also record, for every pair of layers whose amodal silhouettes
intersect, an overlap edge annotated with the back/front assignment and the
covered fraction. These masks and edges are what make the ordered non-overlap
layer sets and the graph-biased communication of the method well defined; they
are computed deterministically from the renderer, not discovered from pixels.

blocks.en:
The rule in Eq. ( 4 ) never places an element in the
same or an earlier group than an already processed element that it overlaps.
Thus every overlap keeps SVG paint order, while
Eq. ( 3 ) guarantees that elements sharing a generated layer cannot
overwrite one another. The groups are not based on meaning or element type:
different element types may share a generated layer whenever their full masks do not
overlap. The layers are also not generated one at a time; the group index

The primary comparison (Table 1 ) evaluates four methods:
(i) SVG (LLM-generated) , a reference in which an LLM (Claude Opus 4.8 Anthropic (2026) )
recolors and completes the structural SVG, which is then rasterized with rsvg-convert Lachowicz et al. (2014) ; this yields exact vector text by construction but is not
a photorealistic synthesizer;
(ii) Qwen-Image-2512 ( Qwen Team, 2025a ) , a prompt-only diffusion model conditioned on the
design-concept prompt which is itself derived from the same SVG layout (for fairness in evaluation);
(iii) Ideogram-4 ( Ideogram AI, 2026 ) , a prompt-only open-weights system whose prompt is
constructed from the same SVG layout, with its structural elements serialized
into the structured prompt format the model expects; and
(iv) LayerCanvas , grouped layer-set diffusion
followed by exact SVG text compositing.

record’s structured conditioning; LayerCanvas additionally
consumes the structural layer set.

blocks.en: Appendix C Downstream Applications
blocks.zh: 附录C 下游 应用程序

blocks.en:
This section demonstrates how the hybrid raster-SVG layer-set representation
supports deterministic editing and reuse after generation. Each application uses
the trained grouped layer-set model or a previously generated output from that
model; operations performed only on the persistent structured representation are
identified explicitly.

本节演示混合光栅-SVG层集的表示方式
支持确定生成后的编辑和再利用。 每个应用程序都使用

模式;仅在持续结构化代表基础上开展的行动
明确识别。

blocks.en: C.1 Text editing and localization
blocks.zh: C.1 文本编辑和本地化

blocks.en:
End-to-end raster generators must repaint text whenever wording, typography, or
language changes. Because their glyph generation is data-driven, they may also
favor the visual conventions of a dominant training language rather than
faithfully rendering a requested, less represented script. LayerCanvas instead
generates only the visual substrate and preserves typography as styled SVG
nodes. Copy, style, and locale changes therefore require no diffusion pass and
cannot alter the generated artwork.

Each text node retains its Unicode content, position, font family, size, weight,
style, anchor, fill color, transforms, and parent ownership. Editing replaces
only the requested attributes before the text-only SVG is rasterized and
alpha-composited over the unchanged model output. Localization uses a
script-appropriate local font and shaping direction; nonlinguistic values such
as numbers and code may remain unchanged. Figure 13 shows the same generated layers with text rendered in four languages.

blocks.en: C.2 Independent layer animation
blocks.zh: C.2 独立层动画

blocks.en:
We adapt the zero-shot animation principle of
Text2Video-Zero Khachatryan et al. (2023) , which shows that the motion
and appearance priors of a pretrained text-to-image diffusion model can produce
a temporally linked sequence without video-specific training. A flattened
document would still expose the complete page to this generative update, allowing
unrelated illustrations, layout, and typography to drift. LayerCanvas instead
lets the temporal operation target one named image layer while all other layers
remain fixed.
blocks.zh:
我们调整了零镜头动画原则
Text2Video-Zero Khachatryan等人(2023年),显示该动议
并且预加训练的文本到图像传播模型的出现前科可以产生
a 时间上相连的序列,不进行视频特定培训。 一个扁平的
文档仍然会将完整页面暴露于这一基因更新,从而允许
不相关的插图,布局,以及漂移的排版. 反之则图层
让时间操作瞄准一个命名的图像层,而所有其他的图层
保持固定状态。

blocks.en:
Following Text2Video-Zero, we derive a short motion trajectory from an image
diffusion prior rather than training a video model. The user selects an image
layer, optionally together with a bounded subregion, and specifies endpoint
states or a motion transform. Intermediate states are produced through latent
interpolation or motion-guided warping, decoded only for the selected content,
and alpha-composited over the unchanged layer set at each timestep. This final
step is specific to our representation: every unselected image layer and the
full-resolution SVG typography are copied identically into every frame. In
Figure 5 , the selected subregion
is an eye band covering 6.6 % 6.6\% of the canvas.

传播先于而不是训练一个视频模型。 用户选择图像

状态或运动改变。 中间状态通过潜伏

完全分辨率的 SVG 排版技术被同样复制到每个帧。 内
图5 选定次区域

blocks.en:
The generative component supplies motion only; spatial isolation comes from the
LayerCanvas representation. Pixels outside the selected region and the complete
vector-text layer are not predicted at subsequent timesteps, so they remain
bit-identical by construction. This converts a global zero-shot image animation
method into a local document operation and avoids spending temporal model
capacity on content that should not move.

blocks.en: C.3 Asset reuse and recomposition
blocks.zh: C.3 联合国 资产再利用和重组

blocks.en:
A flattened image binds every illustration, diagram, and decorative element to
its original page. Reusing one of them requires segmentation followed by
inpainting or regeneration of the surrounding content. LayerCanvas instead keeps
generated visual groups as addressable image layers with their own alpha and
paint order, so an element can become a reusable asset after generation.
blocks.zh:
平整的图像将每个插图、图表和装饰元素结合到
它的原始页面。 重用其中之一需要分解,然后
插入或再生周围内容。 换句话说,
生成视觉组作为可地址的图像层,带有自己的α和
油漆令,因此元素可以在生成后成为可重复使用的资产.

blocks.en:
A selected layer is copied with its image content and alpha mask. Standard
layer operations then translate or scale it, adjust its appearance within the
mask, and assign a new position in the target paint order. Multiple selected
layers may be placed onto a new background and combined with newly authored SVG
text. These operations act on the saved representation and do not require
segmentation, inpainting, or another diffusion pass. Figure 14 shows three layers reused in a new composition.

层操作然后翻译或缩放,调整其在
遮罩,并指定目标油漆顺序中的新位置。 选择多个
层可以放置在新背景上,并与新作者的 SVG 合并
语句。 这些行动对节省的代表权采取行动,不要求
分化,涂抹,或者另一个传播通道. 图14显示在新的成分中再利用的三层。

blocks.en:
Figure 14: Asset reuse. Three generated layers are taken from one
document and arranged into a new composition. Each layer carries its own

blocks.zh:
图14:资产再利用。 三个生成的层从一个中取出
文档并排列成新的组成。 每层都有自己的
alpha),允许独立重新定位,缩放,重排,以及重排.

blocks.en:
Reuse preserves the generated appearance of an asset while decoupling it from
the document in which it first appeared. A collection of generated layers can
therefore serve as a project-specific asset library: recurring illustrations or
diagram components may be placed across related documents while layout and text
remain independently editable. The resulting composition is still structured,
so the reused layer can be moved, hidden, or replaced again later.

再使用保留了资产产生的外观,同时将其与
它首次出现的文档。 生成层的集合可以
因此,作为项目特定资产库:经常性插图或
图表组件在布局和文本时可放在相关文档之间

blocks.en: C.4 Layout retargeting and responsive resize
blocks.zh: C.4 调整布局和反应能力

blocks.en:
A design may need to appear as a presentation slide, poster, and mobile graphic.
Resizing a flattened page either distorts its elements or removes content through
cropping. LayerCanvas retains the document as addressable groups, allowing the
same generated content to be arranged for a different canvas.
blocks.zh:
设计可能需要作为演示幻灯片、海报和移动图形出现。
调整平整页面的大小, 要么扭曲其元素, 要么删除内容
裁缝。 LayerCanvas 保留文档为可地址组,允许
相同的生成内容将排列为不同的画布 。

blocks.en:
Each illustration, diagram, card, and text block carries a bounding box and
group assignment. A simple reflow solver packs these groups in reading order,
using more columns on wide canvases and a vertical stack on narrow ones.
Generated image groups are scaled uniformly, while SVG text can be re-rendered
for the new box. The operation changes only layout metadata and recomposition;
the image layers are not generated again. Figure 15 shows the same content adapted to slide, poster, and mobile layouts.

团队任务。 简单的回流解析器按读取顺序对这些组进行包装,
在宽的画布上使用更多的柱子,在窄的画布上使用垂直堆栈.
生成的图像组被统一缩放, 而 SVG 文本可以重发
为新盒子。 操作只改变布局元数据,重新组合;
图像层不再生成。 图15显示了与幻灯片、海报和移动版式相同的内容。

blocks.en:
Figure 15: Layout retargeting. The same generated module illustration,

mobile canvases. Image groups preserve their aspect ratios, while text remains

用于每个目标布局。

blocks.en:
Retargeting becomes a document-layout problem rather than an image-generation
problem. Groups may be reprioritized, resized, or moved between rows without
changing their generated appearance, and the result remains editable after
recomposition. More advanced layout objectives or design templates can replace
the simple solver without changing the underlying representation.

复次结集. 更高级的布局目标或设计模板可以替换

blocks.en: C.5 Command-driven interactive editing
blocks.zh: C.5 命令驱动的互动编辑

blocks.en:
Interactive authoring is naturally expressed through commands such as “remove
this card,” “emphasize this panel,” or “swap this icon.” Prompt-based
regeneration may redraw the entire canvas. Named layer groups instead allow the
command to be grounded to one element and executed as a local, reversible edit.
blocks.zh:
交互式作者自然通过“移动”等命令表达
”或“切换此图标”。 基于即时
再生可能重新绘制整个画布. 命名的层组允许
命令以一个元素为基础,并作为本地可逆编辑执行。

blocks.en:
A lightweight interpreter maps a command to { action , target } \{\textsc{action},\textsc{target}\} using action phrases and aliases for the
document’s semantic groups. We support removing, emphasizing, swapping, and
adding elements. The executor applies the operation to the targeted SVG group or
model-rendered layer. Full-resolution alpha masks define the affected region,
allowing the result to be recomposited without resampling unrelated content.
Figure 16 shows remove, swap, and add
commands applied to selected regions.

blocks.en:
The language interface does not edit pixels directly. It selects an operation
and resolves a semantic target, after which the persistent layer representation
defines the exact region and compositing behavior. Commands can therefore be
previewed, reversed, or chained without resampling the full document. A learned
language parser could replace the lightweight interpreter without changing the
underlying editing operations or their locality.

语言界面不直接编辑像素. 它选择一个操作
并解决语义目标, 之后的持久性层代表
定义准确的区域和堆肥行为。 因此,命令可以是
预览、反转或链条,而不对完整文档进行复制。 一个学到的

blocks.en: C.6 SVG-space refinement and faithful diffusion propagation
blocks.zh: C.6 SVG空间的改进和忠实传播

blocks.en:
An upstream layout proposal may contain a misplaced, mislabeled, or incorrectly
styled element. In a raster-only pipeline this often requires a new prompt or
manual pixel editing. In LayerCanvas, the SVG is a persistent control surface:
the element can be corrected directly, and the model propagates that correction
to the raster without retraining or redesigning the rest of the document.
blocks.zh:
上游布局提案可能含有错误、标签错误或错误的内容
样式元素。 在光栅专用管道中,这往往需要一个新的即时或
手动像素编辑。 在 Layer Canvas 中, SVG 是一个持久的控制表面:
元素可以直接校正,模型传播该校正
无需再培训或重新设计文件的其余部分。

blocks.en:
We deliberately perturb one SVG element by translating, resizing, recoloring,
relabeling, or replacing it. The incorrect and corrected conditions use the same
sampling noise so that differences are attributable to the structural edit.
Composition uses each group’s full-resolution vector alpha mask rather than an
upsampled latent-grid mask. Figure 6 presents the incorrect condition, the SVG edit, and the corrected render as a
matched triptych.
blocks.zh:
我们刻意通过翻译、调整大小、重新涂色 来干扰一个SVG元素
重新贴标签,或者替换它。 错误的、经纠正的条件使用相同的
取样噪声,使差异归因于结构编辑.
组成使用每个组的全分辨率矢量α掩码而不是一个
高标本潜网面具。 图6列出不正确的条件,SVG编辑,更正后为
匹配的三脚架。

blocks.en:
The structured intermediate remains editable after an initial generation rather
than becoming a disposable prompt. A user or upstream layout system can inspect
the result, correct the responsible SVG group, and regenerate the affected
visual content under the revised condition. Fixed noise helps preserve the
remaining appearance, while recomputing masks and overlap relations allows
changes in position, scale, or occlusion to propagate consistently.
blocks.zh:
结构化中间体在初始生成后仍可编辑
而不是成为一次性的提示。 用户或上游布局系统可以检查
纠正负责的SVG组,使受影响的人再生
修改条件下的视觉内容。 固定的噪音有助于保存

blocks.en: Appendix D Limitations, ethics, and broader impact.
blocks.zh: 附录D 限制、道德和更广泛的影响。

blocks.en: Despite these benefits, LayerCanvas requires a valid source SVG and inherits errors and biases in its content, layout, and training data. Deterministic typography preserves supplied text but does not ensure factuality, accessibility, or culturally appropriate localization, while edits that change occlusion or z-order may affect unintended regions. Responsible deployment therefore requires documented data provenance, license and bias checks, generated-content disclosure, and human review.
blocks.zh: 尽管有这些好处,LayerCanvas需要有效的源SVG,并继承其内容、布局和培训数据的错误和偏差。 决定性的打字法保留了所提供的文本,但不能确保真实性、可获取性或文化上合适的本地化,而编辑这种改变隔离或z顺序可能影响意想不到的区域。 因此,负责任的部署需要有文件记录的数据来源、许可证和偏见检查、生成内容的披露和人力审查。
